faq.q: When does tuna season start in Marbella in 2031?
faq.a: Tuna season in Marbella typically starts in June and runs through October, with peak activity in August and September. Bluefin tuna migrate through the Strait of Gibraltar and along the Costa del Sol during these months.

faq.q: What boats are available for tuna fishing charters?
faq.a: We offer several boats suitable for fishing charters, including the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Larger vessels like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) provide more deck space. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How much does a tuna fishing charter cost?
faq.a: Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) are €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT.

faq.q: Do I need a fishing license?
faq.a: Yes, a recreational fishing license is required for fishing in Spanish waters. We can help arrange one for you. It typically costs around €25–50 per person and is valid for the duration of your charter.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Fishing gear can be provided at an additional cost.

faq.q: Can I keep the tuna I catch?
faq.a: Yes, you can keep your catch, subject to local regulations and size limits. Bluefin tuna have strict quotas, so we recommend catch-and-release for larger specimens. Your skipper will advise on the rules.

faq.q: What is the best time of day for tuna fishing?
faq.a: Early morning (7–10 AM) and late afternoon (4–7 PM) are generally the most productive times for tuna fishing in Marbella. The water is cooler, and tuna feed closer to the surface.

faq.q: How far from shore do we go for tuna?
faq.a: Tuna are typically found 10–20 nautical miles south of Marbella, in waters 50–100 metres deep. The trip out takes about 30–45 minutes depending on the boat speed.

data.body_html:
If you're planning a tuna season marbella fishing charter 2031, you're in for a treat. The Costa del Sol offers some of the best bluefin tuna fishing in Europe, with the season running from June to October. Whether you're a seasoned angler or a first-timer, our fleet at Boat Rental Marbella has the right boat for your trip.

When is Tuna Season in Marbella?

Bluefin tuna migrate through the Strait of Gibraltar from June to October. The peak months are August and September, when water temperatures reach 22–24°C. Early morning and late afternoon charters yield the best results. The 2031 season is expected to follow the same pattern, with high catch rates in the summer.

Our Fishing Charter Boats

We offer a range of boats suitable for fishing charters, all departing from Puerto Banús. For small groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal. Larger groups can opt for the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) with ample deck space. All charters include a licensed skipper who knows the best fishing spots.

What's Included in Your Charter

Every fishing charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish VAT. Fishing gear (rods, reels, bait) can be provided at an additional cost—just let us know in advance.

Where We Fish

We depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. The best tuna grounds are 10–20 nautical miles south, near the underwater seamounts and drop-offs. Common spots include the area off Cabo de la Plata and the waters between Marbella and Estepona. Your skipper will adjust based on conditions and fish activity.

Tips for a Successful Tuna Charter

  • Book early—peak season slots fill fast.
  • Bring sunscreen, a hat, and a light jacket (sea breeze can be cool).
  • Motion sickness medication is recommended for sensitive guests.
  • Respect catch limits and local regulations—your skipper will advise.
  • Consider a full-day (8h) charter for the best chance of landing a big one.

Why Choose Boat Rental Marbella?

We're a local operator based in Puerto Banús, not an affiliate. Our boats are well-maintained, and our skippers are experienced with the local waters. We offer transparent pricing with no hidden fees. For a tuna season marbella fishing charter 2031, you can trust us to deliver a safe and productive day on the water.
